newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's peso closes higher at 1,045.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's peso closes higher at 1,045.

text.p: Colombia's peso strengthened 2.5 pesos to close at 1,045 as banks moved to sell dollars, interbank traders said on Wednesday.

"Banks with long dollar positions were selling all day," one dealer said. She added that the slight gains in the peso this week reflected the fact that institutions had been holding too many dollars. Oil exporters and foreign investors were also moving to cash in greenbacks, dealers said.
"Demand was low and very erratic," according to one trader who said the dollar was under pressure throughout the session.
Dealers reported 360 trades for a total of $152 million. The dollar reached an intraday low of 1,041.60 pesos and averaged 1,046.53 pesos over the day's trading.
